title_en: Why Do Onions Make You Cry? The Hidden Gas 😭 #shorts
description:
Pyaaz kaatte hi aankhein kyun jalne lagti hain? Pyaaz ke andar chhupa ek raaz…
Chhuri, ek an-dekhi gas, aur aap ki aankh ka alarm — 40 second mein poori kahani.

Why do onions make you cry? Cutting breaks the onion's tiny cells, two hidden chemicals mix and make an invisible gas that reaches your eyes — so your eyes make tears to wash it away.

پیاز کاٹتے ہی آنسو کیوں آتے ہیں؟ پیاز کا اپنا خفیہ ہتھیار!

description_en:
Why do onions make you cry? Cutting breaks the onion's tiny cells, two hidden chemicals mix and make an invisible gas that drifts up to your eyes. Your eyes sense it and flood it away with tears. It's the onion's own defence against animals — and a cold onion and a sharp knife mean fewer tears.
